name: Farseer's Echo
summary: Once per long rest, for 1 minute, whenever you cast a Warlock, Divination, or Telekinesis power, choose one ally within 30 ft. That ally may move 5 ft or add +1d4 to their next attack roll, saving throw, or ability check before your next turn.
